title: Alpha One — event AccountBreached v1
description: V1 catalog event `AccountBreached` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = NOT-01 (template: breach), ANA-01. Derived from: docs/07 §3.2 (ACTIVE→BREACH_DETECTED side effect 'AccountBreached (LCC-23)'); verdict fields per docs/09 §3.3/§3.4 (rule, limit_cents, tolerance_cents, input_hash) and docs/32 `evaluations`. Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

rule.description: the breached rule id (e.g. max_daily_loss, max_total_loss, time_limit — D30)

evidence_ref.description: pointer to the EVL evidence snapshot (evaluations.detail: metrics at decision time)
